sourceInference: Pinned LSP4IJ CancellationSupport wraps feature futures, and ResponseErrorException follows the default notification path. GoLanguageClient currently only overrides applyEdit; filtering showMessage there would not address this feature-future path.
The run gutter Information icon is shared by CHECKING/IGNORED/INVALID/ERROR; only current authoritative Go metadata IGNORED is an exclusion classification.

Per-file isEnabled and post-initialization isSupported hooks can defer these two package-dependent providers without changing document synchronization, diagnostics, transport errors or server capabilities.

Pinned LSPSemanticTokensSupport and LSPIntentionCodeActionSupport normally cache null/empty provider results through AbstractLSPDocumentFeatureSupport using the PSI modification stamp. Metadata completion can change eligibility without a PSI edit, so daemon restart alone does not clear those cached results.

behavior.CHECKING: Temporarily defer these providers; existing coalesced metadata operation requests daemon refresh on completion.
behavior.IGNORED: Do not request semantic tokens or LSP code actions for this current excluded document.
behavior.ACTIVE_INVALID_ERROR: Preserve normal provider/capability/request/error paths; malformed metadata and source are not disguised as exclusions.
behavior.serverSettingsEpoch: For GoLanguage source only, post-initialization support requires the factory initialize-options settings snapshot to match current project settings. Delve-only changes are excluded because they do not restart gopls. GoMod/GoWork and other non-GoLanguage files retain the original superclass capability path and are not subject to this Go-source membership/epoch gate.
behavior.documentState: Reuse existing document/metadata invalidation; no synchronous go list, filesystem or subprocess operation is introduced in the feature hooks.
behavior.cacheRefresh: The existing metadata completion/invalidation refresh path schedules background work to capture existing LSPFileSupport objects under a short read action. Outside the read lock and off the EDT, it cancels only semantic tokens and intention code-action supports, then schedules daemon restart on the EDT. No old membership snapshot is delivered; each subsequent provider query reads current metadata and initialization settings. A coalesced old refresh may conservatively cancel a newer request; this is not a claim of zero redundant cancellation.
behavior.initializedServerRecovery: When a current-settings server reports started, the factory asks an already-created metadata service to refresh its observed entry targets. This uses the same two-support cache clear and daemon restart path, rather than relying on a new wrapper openedDocuments list before reconnect. It clears intention cached-empty results that an old initialization epoch rejected after metadata was already ACTIVE.

eligibilityTestSource.fixtureCorrection: holdInitialization creates a two-entry CountDownLatch.
